items.summary: Cost-to-learn is not calculable because experiment-level cost and incremental attributable outcomes are unavailable. Minimum measurement: per-experiment cost plus pre/post or control-based incremental site-attributed commission or conversion outcome. Impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, AI calls, SEO scores, social coverage, and technical scores are operating metrics, not financial returns.

Budget exposure is unbounded: monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue floor, and attribution materiality threshold are blank. Infrastructure spend is unknown because no infrastructure-cost source is present; do not infer it from AI spend. Minimum measurement: owner-approved limits for each field and an actual-versus-budget report. Continue source-dated measurement only; do not request duplicate telemetry.

Reject implied financial upside from existing product, CRO, SEO, or research recommendations. No forecast is supported by the available one-day revenue window, partial attribution, absent cost ledger, or missing experiment incrementality. Keep private launch gates unchanged and retain only existing workstreams.
Revenue evidence covers one day: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission. ROI, margin, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, causal lift, and forecasted upside remain unknown.
